seo.homeTitle: BanG Dream! Our Notes Database & Viewer

descriptions.home: BanG Dream! Our Notes database and wiki with songs, member cards, Snapshots, stories and events, Live2D and Spine viewers, chart players and team-building tools.
descriptions.catalog: Browse the BanG Dream! Our Notes database and wiki for songs, member cards, Snapshots, characters, stories and events, with chart previews and Live2D or Spine viewers.
descriptions.catalogItem: Explore detailed information about {title} and its related entries on haneoka, the BanG Dream! Our Notes resource archive for songs, cards, characters, stories and game systems.
descriptions.about: Discover haneoka’s game archive, story and chart players, Live2D and Spine tools, community and public APIs. Learn how Vega, Altair, Deneb and Cassiopeia work together, explore the open-source repositories and follow the project’s technology.
descriptions.community: Discover BanG Dream! Our Notes community posts, discussions and creative contributions. Comment and reply, like or bookmark interesting posts, follow authors and explore related songs, characters and stories.
descriptions.communityTags: Find BanG Dream! Our Notes community topics and creative contributions by tag. Explore related posts and authors, join discussions, and save or share the game content that interests you.
descriptions.communityPlaylists: Discover BanG Dream! Our Notes playlists shared by the community. Browse song covers, bands and track details, listen to music, bookmark favourite playlists and explore related songs and charts.
descriptions.communitySongs: Explore BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! songs with multilingual titles, bands, credits and chart difficulties. View covers and release information, open song details and chart previews, and access Sonolus levels.
descriptions.communityStories: Read BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! event, band, main, area, after-live and card stories. Follow dialogue with character portraits, view complete card artwork and use the available content-language fallback.
descriptions.terms: Read the rules for using haneoka and its community. Learn the requirements for accounts, posts, uploads, reports and moderation, and review resource use, copyright and service terms.
descriptions.privacy: Learn how haneoka handles account details, cookies, community content, uploaded files and visit records. Read about data use, storage, security, user rights, privacy settings and contact options.
descriptions.general: Explore {title} on haneoka, the BanG Dream! Our Notes database and wiki. Follow related game information and use resource viewers and browser tools.
descriptions.announcements: Read BanG Dream! Our Notes announcements, event news, recruitment notices, maintenance updates and known issues. View full articles, images and publication dates in the available language for your selected server.
descriptions.stampMaker: Create stamps with game artwork or your own images. Edit text, fonts, outlines, and layout, then export a transparent PNG.
descriptions.chartEditor: Create and edit rhythm-game charts in the browser chart editor. Work with notes and connectors, preview the chart and manage local projects.
descriptions.teamBuilder: Use the Our Notes team builder tool with member cards, Snapshots, character ranks and band items. Compare regular, GEKISO and event-reward teams, manage your cards and import game saves.
descriptions.songPuzzle: Solve sliding puzzles using Our Notes song jackets. Choose a song and board size, shuffle tiles, view hints, and track moves and time.
descriptions.tools: Browser tools for BanG Dream! Our Notes: team builder and optimizer, chart editor and viewer, Live2D and Spine model viewers, story player and stamp maker.

resources.songs: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes song credits, bands and release information. Compare chart difficulties and note counts, open the chart player or chart image, view rankings and access Sonolus levels.
resources.characters: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes character artwork, profiles and bands. Browse related cards, voices, Live2D models and stories, and follow connections to performances, relationships and game content.
resources.member-cards: Browse BanG Dream! Our Notes member card artwork, attributes, rarity, power and performance skills. Compare level and rank progression, review materials for the current upgrade and explore character stories.
resources.support-cards: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes support card artwork, attributes, rarity, stats and skills. Review level and rank progression, required upgrade materials, related characters and other connected game information.
resources.band-items: Compare BanG Dream! Our Notes band item effects, unlock conditions and level progression. Review coins and materials for the current upgrade and explore related bands, characters and items.
resources.live2d: Use the BanG Dream! Our Notes Live2D viewer to switch motions and expressions, adjust parameters and parts, save poses and screenshots, and download model resources.
resources.spine: Use the BanG Dream! Our Notes Spine animation viewer for characters, scenes and decorations. Adjust the preview, export transparent PNG images and explore related models.
resources.stories: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes band, event, relationship, home and after-live stories. Read dialogue with character portraits and expandable media, or open the story player for scenes, models and performances.
resources.events: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes event schedules, gameplay, rewards and related stories. Browse linked recruitment, featured cards and songs to understand the event and follow game updates.

gekisoHelp.membersBody: The three minimums can add up to at most 5. Choose the minimum number of members for each GEKISO skill type. Snapshots are counted separately from members and do not fill these slots. The remaining slots are selected for your score goal. COMBO multipliers and JUST window increases have separate minimums.
gekisoHelp.membersExample: For example, choose at least 2 COMBO, 2 JUST and 1 LUCK members. Member counts specify the formation; skill conditions and the selected growth still determine its score.
gekisoHelp.comboBody: This minimum checks the sustained multiplier at the opening COMBO, at starting LIFE. Conditional COMBO skills still take effect later in scoring when their conditions are met. Use member counts to include conditional COMBO members without requiring their bonus at the opening.
gekisoHelp.comboExample: If two active skills add +2 and +3 at the opening, the base multiplier is ×6: the original ×1 plus both bonuses. Two COMBO members can have a different multiplier at different skill levels.
gekisoHelp.justBody: Partial coverage accepts timed Snapshot effects. The target uses the actual JUST HIT Zone after activation, stacking limits and expiry. Every selected JUST section must meet the note coverage and duration conditions.
gekisoHelp.justExample: For a target of +200% and 20% coverage, at least 20% of JUST-eligible notes in each section must reach that window. Sustained window keeps the tap-window minimum after opening activation.
gekisoHelp.luckBody: Expected value calculates the mean from the lottery probabilities. Random simulations average complete plays over a fixed set of random seeds. The number is a calculation setting, not a personal luck value or a percentage.
gekisoHelp.luckExample: 32 runs use seeds 0–31; 128 runs use 0–127 and take longer. Expected value corresponds to the old value 0. Event rewards use 32 simulated runs in automatic mode.
gekisoHelp.placementsBody: These placements determine each range’s score bonus. Selecting first place scores the team under that assumption; the score goal still ranks teams by total score. Match the member types to the range missions when choosing the formation.
gekisoHelp.placementsExample: For a chart without LUCK, Opponent scores accepts up to four opponents’ range scores in each field and derives placements from the team’s average range scores. It does not prioritize winning all three ranges.
gekisoHelp.membersAll: ALL members count toward each type.
gekisoHelp.sectionsBody: The base score excludes placement bonuses. Section priority keeps the selected base score loss limit relative to the total-score team and improves the weakest section against that reference. With reference opponents, it compares task count, section score and PERFECT HIT count, then prioritizes expected section wins.
gekisoHelp.sectionsExample: Reference opponents use the selected chart and stage rules and play under their preset placements. Saved teams capture growth when added; comparison teams retain their growth and accuracy. Automatic uses 32 samples; deterministic runs are merged. Manual counts are retained. Scenario wins include shared first place; all-three wins come from complete plays.
gekisoHelp.accuracyBody: The JUST ratio fixes the initial JUST judgements. Conversion skills can change them afterward. Wider timing windows do not automatically increase this ratio; the window minimum is a separate condition.
gekisoHelp.accuracyExample: Temporary window effects can be active at low limit breaks and still fail a sustained window minimum after they expire. Choose a window minimum to retain timing support, or set Snapshot skill-role limits to retain conversion skills.
